name: Eachtach

attributes.attribute: an Irish heroine, loyal daughter of Diarmait Ua Duibne
the beloved spouse of Diarmait Ua Duibne and mother of Eachtach
attacked Fionn Mac Cumhaill after his refusal to help her father

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eachtach is an Irish heroine and the loyal daughter of Diarmait Ua Duibne and Gráinne. She attacked Fionn Mac Cumhaill, her father's lord. Fionn had refused to stand by Diarmait as he fought to the death with an enchanted boar. Her blow followed this refusal of aid to her father.

okr.objective: Describe Eachtach, the loyal daughter who attacked Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
key_results: Eachtach was the loyal daughter of Diarmait Ua Duibne and Gráinne.
She attacked Fionn Mac Cumhaill, her father's lord.
